description: AUA wall: read up to 5 talks of one board (use = a use id, or addr + iface = a tool; neither = graffiti). The talk text never reaches you: each one is read through MCP sampling with no context and no tools, and you get only wall codes {topic, claim, cond, refs, risk, theme, tone} and ids (enums in aua.json schema, wall.*). Without sampling support it reads nothing.
name: wall
